tour.title: Project overview
tour.description: Read the README for the purpose, supported inputs and output formats. It also distinguishes the local Windows app from the separate, unpublished Gradio Space.

tour.title: Local Streamlit workbench
tour.description: The Streamlit entry point accepts documents and page selections, shows previews and loads the GPU engine when parsing starts. Its presentation helper prepares sanitized views and downloads without requiring inference during navigation.
tour.languageLesson: A Streamlit cache_resource decorator shares a loaded model resource across reruns; the engine serializes access with a lock.

tour.title: Space entry point
tour.description: The Gradio entry point uses the same converter and engine in a separate ZeroGPU process. Its UI and session helper validate uploads, enforce workload limits and manage temporary results.

tour.title: Render and convert
tour.description: The shared conversion module validates page ranges, renders PDFs or image frames and calls the page parser. It saves source images, annotations and exports; complete cache entries are reused while incomplete results are retried.
tour.languageLesson: A Python generator can produce selected page images one at a time rather than materializing every page.

tour.title: Layout and recognition
tour.description: The engine loads pinned PP-DocLayoutV3 and Xiaomi-OCR-0 models on CUDA. It detects page regions, sends crops to task-specific prompts, and records warnings or incomplete output; a page-level fallback handles an empty layout.

tour.title: Normalize model output
tour.description: The postprocessing helpers convert OTSL table tokens to escaped HTML and normalize formula delimiters. These transformations feed the Markdown and structured exports produced by the converter.

tour.title: Setup and execution
tour.description: Project metadata selects Python 3.12 and CUDA-enabled dependencies. The setup script downloads pinned snapshots, while the launcher runs Streamlit without synchronizing the environment.

tour.title: Tests and diagnostics
tour.description: The tests exercise region routing, output safety and document limits without requiring real GPU inference. A separate synthetic smoke script checks the locally installed GPU models; its result does not establish accuracy on representative documents.

tour.title: Inspect and export
tour.description: Return to the Streamlit helpers and Space session code to see how rendered pages, JSON and ZIP archives reach the user. Saved local results persist, while Space results are stored in temporary session directories.

tour.title: Further project context
tour.description: The developer guide brings together commands, model setup and deployment limits. Historical audit records describe the older Nemotron implementation and should not be treated as validation of the Xiaomi pipeline.
